statement: Weighted stratified cluster-bootstrap percentile CI under-covers; the pre-registered MET_LOWER_BOUND rule relies on it.
evidence: Simulation, 300 replicates on the exact H-OUT design using author's c13_stats: weighted bootstrap 95% coverage 0.830 at true p=0.983 and 0.923 for heterogeneous p=0.949. Kish-Wilson 0.967-0.977. HT unbiased. Cause: cells with n_h 10-31 and no errors give zero bootstrap variance at weights up to 28 (sim_p98.json, sim_hetero.json).
requested_action: PROTOCOL v1.1 before GA1: base the met lower bound on a conservative interval (e.g. min of Kish-Wilson and bootstrap LB, or a smoothed/BCa stratified bootstrap); add a coverage-simulation test to the suite.

statement: Size and power justification covers only the unweighted analysis, but the headline and met rule are weighted. MET_LOWER_BOUND for outcome is practically unreachable below true precision ~0.99. H-HOLD +/-7pp and H-REL +/-7pp ignore the Kish design effect of their own weights.
evidence: H-OUT Kish deff 2.00 (n_eff ~127 covered). Kish-Wilson LB at true 0.98 = 0.938, at 0.99 = 0.953. Power n=253 is for the unweighted one-sided test. H-HOLD Kish deff 1.49 gives weighted half-width ~8.5pp. H-REL overall Kish deff 7.5 (NO_DETECTED weights 1199/222); treatment-cue pages deff 1.66 gives ~9pp.
requested_action: Restate size justification for the weighted estimators in PROTOCOL v1.1 and DESIGN notes; tell the owner before coding what MET_LOWER_BOUND can realistically show; do not change the holdouts.

statement: The party-specific stratum cue is mostly noise, so H-OUT will contain very few gold party-specific units and the owner's party-specific breakdown will be uninformative.
evidence: Frame sample: 0/7 PARTY_SPECIFIC labels correct. Dedicated sample of 25/60 candidates: 3 true party-differentiated disposals. Combined 3/27 unique, PPV ~11% (95% CI 4-28%). Regex fires on AFT-writ boilerplate [REDACTED in this copy: quoted sentences; see EXPOSURE_REGISTER.md].
requested_action: PROTOCOL v1.1: state the expected number of gold party-specific units, and pre-declare the party-specific result as descriptive or a stated shortfall when n is small. Improve the cue only for future draws; no redraw.

statement: Holdout judgments pre-exposed through curated/KB material are not on the spent list.
evidence: JK-16dcc07543999d26 (K J S Buttar; H-HOLD+H-REL), JK-76ec35cd7ab232b5 (Himmat Singh Chahar; H-OUT) and JK-88f84411abdb3028 (Ram Swarup; H-OUT) are in C11 curated/CURATED_53_C11.csv and C12 holdings CURATED_SCOPE_C12.csv. JK-05e9484593272fe0 (Baljit Singh; H-OUT) is in WS-B holdings_register.csv. 27 holdout judgments are in C11 scnum SCNUM_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW.csv (case numbers only).
requested_action: Register a pre-exposed subset (per task) in v1.1, and report every headline with and without it. Do not redraw or drop.

statement: No coding-time rule for holdout items found uncodable, unreadable, misidentified or out of scope; gold unclear/other units leave coverage denominators without an explicit reporting rule.
evidence: PROTOCOL_C13.md s.2-s.6 cover frame-level text states only. CODING_GUIDE_outcome.md has no not-codable instruction. c13_score treats gold unclear/other as undeterminable, which drops them from coverage.
requested_action: Add a rule: such items stay in the sample with an explicit code, are counted and reported (n and share), and are never replaced (reserve only under the H-HOLD gold-count rule). Report the number of undeterminable gold units beside coverage.

statement: Near-identical sibling orders (separate proceedings decided in identical terms) link holdout items to spent items. These are not identity duplicates, but they are template leakage.
evidence: 8 holdout judgments have >=0.90 shingle containment against a spent judgment (OUT 5, HOLD 2, REL 1); 13 have a same-date sibling >=0.80. Example: H-HOLD JK-a955c52fc4f33fef (67 pp) vs C12 V3 holdout JK-90cb9635a41396dd, containment 0.92; H-OUT JK-3b5da3990d543f3a vs C11 review JK-79281579ec8a677d, 0.977 (neardup_holdout_vs_spent.csv).
requested_action: List these as a sensitivity subset (with the F04 subset) and report results with and without it.

statement: The scoring harness checks the annotation store only when --store is passed, but the protocol says it refuses a truth file not in a verified store.
evidence: c13_score.main: 'if a.store:' guards verify_store; scoring proceeds without --store.

statement: Returned-sheet leak check exempts notes/excerpt/legal_issue from the model-token scan, and the other-coder check is optional.
evidence: leak_tests.py: notes='AUTOMATED_CANDIDATE_NOT_VERIFIED extractor V4 output: dismissed' passes check_completed_sheet; omitting --other-coder passes.
requested_action: Scan free-text fields for model-only tokens (AUTOMATED_CANDIDATE, OUTCOME_UNVERIFIED, extractor/model ids); make --other-coder required with --completed.

statement: The adjudication X/Y key can be recomputed from the seed constant in the code, so anonymisation holds only while the adjudicator lacks the tool.
evidence: sha256('mimamsa-c13-adjudication|xy|'+item_id) reproduced every X/Y assignment in a 100-item test.
requested_action: Use a secret per-run seed (or random assignment) stored only in the sealed key.

statement: H-REL bootstrap clusters are pages, not judgments as the protocol states; H-REL page classing uses representative-copy J-ids only.
evidence: 160 pages from 123 judgments, but estimate() clusters by item_id (page). rel_pages() keys citations on 'J-'+rep_sha256[:16], so a citation recorded on another copy classes the page NO_DETECTED_CITATION (efficiency only).
requested_action: Pass the judgment_key as the cluster id for H-REL; document the classing limitation.

statement: H-HOLD reserve opening is not implemented in the harness.
evidence: load_design reads SAMPLE.csv only; reserve items would raise 'not in the holdout design'; recomputing pi from the opened n_h is not coded.
requested_action: Implement and test reserve opening (recomputed n_h, pi, weights) before GA2.

statement: Target status is computed only overall; the owner's court-, proceeding- and party-specific requirements are reported as breakdowns without a status, and the protocol does not say whether 'met' applies per breakdown.
evidence: run(): targets_status only for res['overall']; by_court and subsets have no status.
requested_action: State in v1.1 whether met is decided overall or per breakdown (owner decision), and emit a status per breakdown.

evidence: PROTOCOL s.3 says the H-HOLD/H-REL overlap is 14; HOLDOUT_REGISTRATION.json says 15. The H-REL size note names types 'APPLIES, CITES' in upper case, but the vocabulary is lower case.

statement: Frame stratum rules misclassify about a third of records, against the texts; validity is unaffected (correct weights, gold-based subsets).
evidence: 40-record check: court 40/40; text quality 40/40; stratum 24/38 (63%; random part 16/22). Errors: 7 false PARTY_SPECIFIC; 3 pension matters labelled OTHER; 2 SC multi-proceeding judgments missed (no case numbers in SC meta); 2 false BATCH from lower-forum OA numbers in the cause title (frame_sample/SAMPLE.csv).
requested_action: Document measured stratum accuracy in README/PROTOCOL; improve rules only for future frames.

statement: The IMAGE_ONLY rule 5 excludes OCR texts that are readable, narrowing the evaluated population beyond 'unusable'.
evidence: Frame sample #24 (hc-ph-2026-cwp-11618-2026…): OCR text letter share 0.89, readable, but IMAGE_ONLY by rule; 26 judgments are IMAGE_ONLY.
requested_action: Keep as pre-registered; state in reports that OCR-only judgments are excluded by rule, not because they are unreadable.
